This products really didn't do much to help the appearance of my pores, it would work for maybe the first 15 minutes of wearing it, but then my pores looked just the same. I wanted to diminish them. I have not seen any difference at all in my pores since using this cream.   That said, I think this cream goes on really well. It is very light and absorbs into my skin immediately ( the texture is like the original Oil of Olay lotions )and it smells so good. It makes my skin feel s

I've had more expensive pore minimizers.  And by expensive, I mean it was priced like a street drug.  This was the first time I used Loreal and now I understand why they win consumer awards every year.  After using this product, my pores have been visibly smaller and stay clean through out my use.  Even better, it retains softness.  It doesn't have that slightly acid pull that other pore minimizers do.  So for the cost of this product, anyone interested should just try it to see for themselves.

This product instantly makes my pores look smaller.  I would have given 5 stars if there was more of it in the tube.  It evens out skin tone and is truly the only product to make my pores look smaller.  I'm in desperate need of a gylcolic peel but cannot afford it currently.  This product is the next best thing.  It makes my skin smell nice and feel like silk.  Love it!!

For a person with allergies, this has an extremely strong fragrance. I don't see a difference in my pores yet, but I've been only using it for 2 days. I was disappointed to find the coupon enclosed had an expiration date of 2009, so this "new" product must be at least 3 years old. I've tried many pore minimizing products and so for Philosophy's Miracle is the best.

The product smells nice but it doesn't do its job. I have used pore minimizers before (Estee Lauder's pore minimizing serum, witch hazel, nose strips, etc.), yet this one did very little to reduce pore size. Also, it dries really quickly and if you rub your skin, the lotion actually clumps up and rubs off. It's really gross and feels heavy on your skin.

This is a great product that I have used for a couple years, but Loreal has apparently discontinued it.  I have been able to purchase it on Amazon for a greatly reduced price - including shipping - and it has arrived well-packed within the expected timeframe.  I would definitely purchase from this dealer again.

I was trying to give this product the benefit of the doubt but I've used it now for over six months and nada. It doesn't shrink pores like it says it does, or at least not for me. I would not recommend this product but you'll have to be the judge as we all have different skin.

I bought this product from a seller through Amazon. The product I received was over 5 years old! However I know that is not this products fault, maybe it does work? It just didn't work for me and I'm assuming it is because of how old the "brand new" one I received was.

I found there to be a very strong fragrance to this product. The smell was so bad I had to wash this off my face within 30 minutes of applying. I have no idea if this minimizes pores or not as I could not use it more than one time. What a waste of money for me.

I really like this product.  It does make my pores smaller and my skin super smooth.  I am on my second bottle.  The price is so affordable and it does what it says it will do!  I highly recommend this prodect!
This stuff works.  It seems to leave a fine layer on your skin that disguises and covers pores.  Your skin will have a bit of a matte appearance after it dries.  Make up goes on well over it.

claims.text: Many reviewers report that the product visibly reduces the appearance of pores, often noticing results quickly.
Several reviewers say it works well for oily skin and helps control shine.
Some reviewers report no noticeable change in their pores even after extended use.
A few reviewers complain about negative sensory issues such as a strong smell, pasty look, or clogged pores and breakouts.
Some reviewers find it helps makeup apply more smoothly and improves skin texture.
